inputs.accepted: AZ 1512; confirmed unexposed film on Si. Preserves sampleId, revision, contactIds. Uses only a digital 10×10 mm center crop; grid nx × nz, origin_mm[2], pitch_mm, µm thickness values or null holes in wafer-centered +x right,+z front. 0–4 µm supported.

8–1,000 increasing wavelengthNm values within 400–850 nm, reflectanceUnit='fraction', wavelengthUnit='nm'; revision and contactIds required; optics.model must be one of silicaSi, AZ1500Si, constantGlass, indexMatched. Imported spectra are calibrated, not arbitrary raw camera pixels.

outputs.data: Simulated sampleCounts/referenceCounts/darkCounts (arbitrary counts), calibrated reflectance fraction; xMm/zMm specimen coordinate, spotDiameterUm, sample and contacts, input revision and spectrum revision.

model, searchNm, thicknessNm or null, candidateNm or null, RMS absolute reflectance, residual vector and alternative thicknesses in nm. Parent spectrum revision and output revision. Input origin not authenticated.

outputs.timeBase: none; spectral axis not a time series

limits: One planar, uniform, isotropic, nonabsorbing film; semi-infinite substrate optionally complex. No high-NA pupil average, surface roughness, multilayer inversion or source-specific vendor uncertainty.
